mapper.select: SELECT t.name AS name, IFNULL(o.counts,0) AS value FROM ( SELECT 0 status, '待付款' name UNION ALL SELECT 1, '待发货' UNION ALL SELECT 2, '已发货' UNION ALL SELECT 3, '已完成' UNION ALL SELECT 4, '已取消' ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_status,count(order_status) counts from orders where deleted = 0 GROUP BY order_status ) o ON t.status = o.order_status ORDER BY t.status

SELECT t.day AS name, IFNULL(o.cnt, 0) AS value FROM ( SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY AS day UNION ALL SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 5 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 4 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 3 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 2 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURDATE() ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS create_day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) o ON t.day = o.create_day ORDER BY t.day;
